response.justification: While Bogdan is clearly a talented, senior-level engineer with strong software craftsmanship practices and experience building complex systems, there is a fundamental mismatch with the core technical requirements of this role. The position demands deep expertise in Java, Kotlin, and the Spring ecosystem—areas where the candidate has minimal demonstrable experience. The resume shows a career trajectory focused on web development, infrastructure, and AI tooling rather than JVM ecosystem development or IDE internals. For a mid-senior individual contributor role requiring immediate productivity, the steep learning curve needed to acquire these prerequisite technical skills makes this an unsuitable match.
strengths: Demonstrates strong software craftsmanship with proven expertise in TDD, CI/CD, and clean architecture practices across multiple senior roles
Extensive experience building and maintaining complex, large-scale systems (micro-services handling millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby; distributed geo-data platform)
Active open-source contributor and community educator, showing ability to design extensible systems and communicate technical concepts effectively
concerns: Minimal Java/Kotlin experience; resume shows only brief mentions in older roles with no evidence of deep JVM understanding or modern enterprise Java development
No demonstrated experience with Spring ecosystem, Quarkus, Hibernate, or other enterprise frameworks that are core to the position's technical focus
Limited IDE and language tooling expertise; only 7 months at LabWindows/CVI (2014-2015) with career trajectory focused on web development and infrastructure rather than IDE internals

key_factors.factor: Spring ecosystem and enterprise framework experience
Software craftsmanship and architectural design skills
